Harmony Farm Sanctuary (HFS) is a nonprofit vegan farm sanctuary in beautiful Central Oregon. Our mission is two-fold; first, we rescue, rehabilitate and provide an excellent home for retired, unwanted or abused farmed animals. Second, we strive to build compassion for all sentient beings.

Currently, Harmony Farm Sanctuary is home to more than 130 rescued farm animals! They depend 100% on donors like you for all of their care.

501(c)3 Not-for-Profit for Farm Animal Rescue
Federal ID# 47-4073127.
